texts.NIV84: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn out its seven pillars.
texts.KJV: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
texts.NKJV:
Wisdom has built her house,
She has hewn out her seven pillars;
texts.DRB: Wisdom hath built herself a house, she hath hewn her out seven pillars.

texts.NIV84: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.
texts.KJV: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
texts.NKJV:
She has slaughtered her meat,
She has mixed her wine,
She has also furnished her table.
texts.DRB: She hath slain her victims, mingled her wine, and set forth her table.

texts.NIV84: She has sent out her maids, and she calls from the highest point of the city.
texts.KJV: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
texts.NKJV:
She has sent out her maidens,
She cries out from the highest places of the city,
texts.DRB: She hath sent her maids to invite to the tower, and to the walls of the city:

texts.NIV84: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.
texts.KJV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
texts.NKJV:
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!”
As for him who lacks understanding, she says to him,
texts.DRB: Whosoever is a little one, let him come to me. And to the unwise she said:

texts.NIV84: "Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.
texts.KJV: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
texts.NKJV:
“Come, eat of my bread
And drink of the wine I have mixed.
texts.DRB: Come, eat my bread, and drink the wine which I have mingled for you.

texts.NIV84: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.
texts.KJV: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
texts.NKJV:
Forsake foolishness and live,
And go in the way of understanding.
texts.DRB: Forsake childishness, and live, and walk by the ways of prudence.

texts.NIV84: "Whoever corrects a mocker invites insult; whoever rebukes a wicked man incurs abuse.
texts.KJV: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
texts.NKJV:
“He who corrects a scoffer gets shame for himself,
And he who rebukes a wicked man only harms himself.
texts.DRB: He that teacheth a scorner, doth an injury to himself: and he that rebuketh a wicked man, getteth himself a blot.

texts.NIV84: Do not rebuke a mocker or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man and he will love you.
texts.KJV: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
texts.NKJV:
Do not correct a scoffer, lest he hate you;
Rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.
texts.DRB: Rebuke not a scorner lest he hate thee. Rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

texts.NIV84: Instruct a wise man and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man and he will add to his learning.
texts.KJV: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
texts.NKJV:
Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser;
Teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
texts.DRB: Give an occasion to a wise man, and wisdom shall be added to him. Teach a just man, and he shall make haste to receive it.

texts.NIV84: "The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
texts.KJV: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
texts.NKJV:
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom,
And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
texts.DRB: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is prudence.

texts.NIV84: For through me your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.
texts.KJV: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
texts.NKJV:
For by me your days will be multiplied,
And years of life will be added to you.
texts.DRB: For by me shall thy days be multiplied, and years of life shall be added to thee.

texts.NIV84: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you; if you are a mocker, you alone will suffer."
texts.KJV: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
texts.NKJV:
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself,
And if you scoff, you will bear it alone.”
texts.DRB: If thou be wise, thou shalt be so to thyself: and if a scorner, thou alone shalt bear the evil.

texts.NIV84: The woman Folly is loud; she is undisciplined and without knowledge.
texts.KJV: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
texts.NKJV:
A foolish woman is clamorous;
She is simple, and knows nothing.
texts.DRB: A foolish woman and clamorous, and full of allurements, and knowing nothing at all,

texts.NIV84: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,
texts.KJV: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
texts.NKJV:
For she sits at the door of her house,
On a seat by the highest places of the city,
texts.DRB: Sat at the door of her house, upon a seat, in a high place of the city,

texts.NIV84: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way.
texts.KJV: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
texts.NKJV:
To call to those who pass by,
Who go straight on their way:
texts.DRB: To call them that pass by the way, and go on their journey:

texts.NIV84: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.
texts.KJV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
texts.NKJV:
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here”;
And as for him who lacks understanding, she says to him,
texts.DRB: He that is a little one, let him turn to me. And to the fool she said:

texts.NIV84: "Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!"
texts.KJV: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
texts.NKJV:
“Stolen water is sweet,
And bread eaten in secret is pleasant.”
texts.DRB: Stolen waters are sweeter, and hid den bread is more pleasant.

texts.NIV84: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of the grave.
texts.KJV: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
texts.NKJV:
But he does not know that the dead are there,
That her guests are in the depths of hell.
texts.DRB: And he did not know that giants are there, and that her guests are in the depths of hell. The Parables of Solomon
